Questions about India representation

What does hotel sales representation in India cover?

A representation brief can include identifying trade and corporate buyers, introducing the property, training partner sellers and following up on proposals. The hotel and Koonafa agree the territory, decision rights and reporting before work starts.

Can an overseas hotel use the India market hub?

Yes. International hotels can start with the India launch guide to assess feeder cities, air access and travel trade requirements before planning an outbound partner programme.

What should I include in a hotel marketing enquiry?

Share your property website, target guests and source markets, priority stay dates, current booking channels and the commercial objective. Include any constraints on room stock or offer approvals.

Bring a commercial brief

Share the property, origin markets, channel mix and the booking periods that need support. Koonafa can use that brief to discuss an appropriate scope and agree what the hotel team will own.
